benchmarks.design: Complete uninstrumented modules, ASCII JSON-string bodies of exactly 64/4096/65536 bytes plus four-byte headers, one frame per push / 16 coalesced / approximately eight body fragments. Four warmup AB/BA pairs and twelve timed AB/BA pairs each. Fresh NativeDecoder per trial, retained across messages. Inputs built before timing; CPU user and system and all durations saved. Initial target 16 MiB/trial with minimum 64 outer iterations; confirmation uses 128 MiB for 4 KiB/64 KiB fixtures, 16 MiB for 64-byte. Coalesced 64 KiB initial minimum means 64 MiB/trial.
